name: loom
description: Shared long-term memory and code intelligence for Codex, self-hosted on ClickHouse. MCP tools to save and recall decisions, preferences and corrections across sessions and teammates; lifecycle hooks that capture each session with no model call; a code index that answers where-is, who-calls and blast-radius questions with line-accurate units instead of whole-file reads.

interface.shortDescription: Shared long-term memory and code index for coding agents, on ClickHouse.
interface.longDescription: Loom gives Codex a memory that outlives the session and is shared with every other agent on the team: decisions, preferences and corrections are captured by lifecycle hooks with no model call, a budgeted primer is loaded at session start, and in a loom-indexed repository the code tools answer structure questions with line-accurate units instead of whole files.
